title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.12762v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. On Taiyi-Bench, an AI co-scientist ideation benchmark comprising 265 tasks from 50 papers across ten disciplines, Sage-Taiyi ranks first on all eight metrics of historical rediscovery and open-ended ideation, achieving an Overall score of 54.0 compared with 47.9 for the strongest baseline, AI Scientist-v2. It also performs well on two external scientific ideation benchmarks. Five expert-guided collaborations further connect its proposals to experimental and computational validation across chemistry, materials science, and engineering. In chemistry

translated_title: Sage-Taiyi：一种面向科学发现的元认知架构
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Sage-Taiyi，一种受元认知启发的架构，它利用积累的科学理解来指导下一步研究什么以及如何开展研究。通过显式的监控与调控，该系统不断修订其对证据、假设和未解决问题的理解，进而利用这些评估来调整研究目标并选择可复用的推理方法。在Taiyi-Bench上——一个包含来自十个学科50篇论文共265个任务的AI科研助手构思基准——Sage-Taiyi在历史重现和开放式构思的全部八项指标上均排名第一，总体得分达到54.0，而最强基线AI Scientist-v2的得分为47.9。该系统还在两个外部科学构思基准上表现良好。五次专家指导的协作进一步将其提出的研究方案与化学、材料科学和工程领域的实验及计算验证相衔接。
tldr: Sage-Taiyi是一种受元认知启发的科学发现架构，通过监控并调控自身对证据与假设的理解来动态调整研究目标和推理方法，在Taiyi-Bench的全部八项指标上超越最强基线AI Scientist-v2排名第一，并经专家协作实现了实验与计算验证。
en_tdlr: Sage-Taiyi is a metacognition-inspired architecture for scientific discovery that adaptively revises its understanding of evidence and assumptions to adjust research targets and reasoning methods, ranking first on all eight Taiyi-Bench metrics against the strongest baseline AI Scientist-v2, with expert-guided experimental validation.
